messages.subject: RJava: Error obtaining System.out
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

  Any idea why trying to obtain System.out in rJava does not work?

> library(rJava)
> .jinit()
> s <- .jnew("java/lang/String", "Hello World!")
> .jcall(s,"I","length")
[1] 12
> systemOut <- .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream", "out")
Error in .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream", "out") :
 RgetField: field out not found

  Thanks!

     Take care
     Oliver

--
Oliver Ruebenacker
Bioinformatics Consultant (http://www.knowomics.com/wiki/Oliver_Ruebenacker)

messages.subject: Re: RJava: Error obtaining System.out
messages.body_plain:
On Jun 7, 2012, at 6:21 PM, Oliver Ruebenacker wrote:

>      Hello,
> 
>   Any idea why trying to obtain System.out in rJava does not work?
> 
>> library(rJava)
>> .jinit()
>> s <- .jnew("java/lang/String", "Hello World!")
>> .jcall(s,"I","length")
> [1] 12
>> systemOut <- .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream", "out")
> Error in .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream", "out") :
>  RgetField: field out not found
> 

You have a typo - missing semicolon:

> .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream;", "out")
[1] "Java-Object{java.io.PrintStream@e76cbf7}"


for the lazy ones:

> J("java.lang.System")$out
[1] "Java-Object{java.io.PrintStream@e76cbf7}"


Cheers,
Simon

messages.subject: Re: RJava: Error obtaining System.out
messages.body_plain:
On Jun 8, 2012, at 7:04 AM, Oliver Ruebenacker <curoli at gmail.com> wrote:

>     Hello Simon,
> 
> On Thu, Jun 7, 2012 at 8:51 PM, Simon Urbanek
> <simon.urbanek at r-project.org> wrote:
>> 
>> You have a typo - missing semicolon:
>> 
>>> .jfield("java/lang/System", "Ljava/io/PrintStream;", "out")
>> [1] "Java-Object{java.io.PrintStream@e76cbf7}"
> 
>  Thank you! How could I have missed that!
> 
>  Out of curiosity - what is the purpose of the semicolon?
> 

To terminate the class name - if you have (foo.D, double) it is "Lfoo.D;D" -- without the semicolon "Lfoo.DD" it would read as class foo.DD instead

Cheers,
Simon
